scope: Read-only corpus inspection using the installed parser and its fence-state rules; no refresh, model calls or retrieval-quality experiment.
limitations: Fence-aware heading division is followed by fixed-character slicing; long examples can be split.
Introductory context is capped at 2000 characters.
Internal links are not exposed as validated page-ID targets.
Section positions belong to a snapshot; source citation IDs belong to a conversation.
Structural readability is not evidence of complete retrieval or answer quality.
